basis.note: Presence in the accepted index is not permission to crawl; each host still needs an explicit owner admission, robots review and rights basis.

phases.name: compliance review
phases.exit: written admission of the source record

phases.name: one host, 20 accepted pages/day, 3 days
phases.exit: zero robots violations, acceptance >= 15%, pacing log complete

phases.name: one host, 100 accepted pages/day, 7 days
phases.exit: acceptance >= 20%, no 429 storm, one recheck outcome recorded

phases.name: second host
phases.exit: separate owner decision and admission record

pending: owner reads robots.txt and site terms manually (no automated fetch in this change)
owner states the rights basis and whether snippet indexing is permitted
owner confirms the user-agent contact address

stop_conditions: fetch to a host without an admitted source
any request inside a robots-disallowed path
robots 5xx or 403, or three consecutive 5xx from one host
429/503: honour full Retry-After, then stop the host for the run
any non-HTML response parsed or any body storage attempted
owner kill switch: set_source_enabled(source_id, false) and stop the scheduler
owner_decisions_required: approve www.london.gov.uk /events and /whats-on for Phase 1 (or substitute a host)
state the rights basis and whether snippet indexing is permitted
confirm the contact address in the user agent
confirm 100 accepted pages/day and the 300-fetch gross ceiling
confirm retention (metadata plus snippet, no body) and the takedown contact
